name: dumbbell narrow squat lunge
description: A narrow-stance lunge holding a dumbbell in each hand to add load for the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
